description: This file contains a PHPUnit test case class for testing the FormatWithBase64Encode class in the OrangeHRM project. It sets up a test environment, populates test data, and verifies that the encoding method correctly Base64 encodes a string.

classes.name: FormatWithBase64EncodeTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing Base64 encoding of values in the FormatWithBase64Encode class.
